You'll soon be working for a company that specializes in producing all kinds of stone worktops. These worktops are sold throughout the Netherlands and Germany and eventually end up in people's homes, so there's a good chance that you already have one of their worktops in your own kitchen! 
As an Assembly Worker, you'll be responsible for the finishing tasks that cannot be completed by machines. You'll be working on detailed operations using hand tools and small machinery. Once you've mastered your own process, you'll have the opportunity to move on to the next department within production! 
Your main tasks will include: - Assembling materials using hand tools - Reading technical drawings - Performing quality checks - Communicating with the machining department - Keeping your workspace clean and organized 
Your new job as an Assembly Worker takes place in a day shift, Monday to Friday, from 06:00 am to 15:00 pm. Leaving your weekends free!
